ProjectsPage.title: Personal Projects
ProjectsPage.birdClassificationName: Bird Classication Model Deep Neural Network (Beta)
ProjectsPage.nailSalonDescript: A mobile appointment-booking app for a nail salon, built with React Native and Expo. Users sign up and sign in with Clerk authentication, browse a gallery of nail designs, and select services before booking a time slot on a calendar that checks real-time availability against each service's duration. Bookings, cancellations, and booking history are synced through a Hygraph GraphQL backend, and users can manage their profile, including updating their photo and password, from the settings screen.
ProjectsPage.calculator: This project is a calculator app with the functionality that help solve simple math. Its inspired by widgets found on smartphones. In this project I was more focused on responsive design
ProjectsPage.weatherAppDescript: A weather app built with Next.js and TypeScript that pulls real-time data from the OpenWeatherMap API. On load it uses geolocation to detect the user's location, falling back to the last searched city, and a debounced search bar with live city autocomplete lets users look up any location worldwide. It shows current conditions, including temperature, real feel, humidity, pressure, wind speed and direction, rain, and visibility, alongside a 3-hour interval 5-day forecast, a 5-day outlook summary, sunrise and sunset times, and an air quality index. The interface supports toggling between Celsius/Fahrenheit and English/Japanese, with dynamic backgrounds that change with the weather condition.
ProjectsPage.birdClassificationDescript: In this project I used a convolutional neural network to build a model which takes images as inputs and through its deep convolutional layers extracts the features of this image and classify it as one of the classes or species through the multi-class classification system of this model.
ProjectsPage.foodAppDescript: The Food App is a small project built with React Native in Expo. It simulates the user experience of selecting a restaurant and viewing its menu. The app provides a simple and intuitive interface for browsing restaurant options and exploring available dishes
ProjectsPage.portfolioAppDescript: This is the website you are currently visiting. I built it using modern web technologies to ensure a smooth and responsive experience. It is designed to be fully accessible and user-friendly on a variety of devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. No matter what device you are using, the layout adjusts seamlessly to provide an optimal viewing experience
ProjectsPage.otoDecksDescript: OtoDecks is a desktop DJ application I built in C++ using the JUCE framework. It lets users load and control two audio tracks independently, adjust volume and playback speed, and navigate tracks using waveform displays, with a crossfader to mix between decks. It also includes a searchable playlist with XML-based saving and loading. I structured the project around object-oriented design, with separate classes for audio playback, deck UI, waveform visualization, playlist management, and mixer controls.
ProjectsPage.flowerArrangementDescript: PetalPalette is a flower arrangement system that helps users design bouquets using color theory. Users upload a photo and the app extracts its dominant colors, then suggests complementary, monochromatic, and polychromatic flower pairings drawn from a flower color wheel. An AI chatbot, built with a RAG pipeline over a flower-meanings knowledge base and an Ollama-hosted LLM, gives personalized recommendations and explains the meaning behind each flower choice. The project is built with a Python/FastAPI backend, a Next.js and TypeScript frontend, and is containerized with Docker.

AboutPage.title: About Me
AboutPage.bio: I'm a software engineer with a BSc in Computer Science from the University of London, driven by a strong appetite for learning and adapting quickly to new tools and environments. Through academic and personal projects I've built experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, and Python, including a university research project applying Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), REST and GraphQL APIs, and SQL to data analysis. In June 2026 I completed Kikagaku's AI/DX Human Resource Development Program, a METI-certified "Re-skilling" course covering data analysis, machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing. Years spent teaching English also shaped how I work — explaining complex ideas clearly, communicating across cultures, and solving problems on the fly — skills I bring directly into team-based software development.
